purpose: Provide a traceable failure-mode skeleton for UAV-014 without inventing severity, occurrence, detection scores, response timings or a final safe-state policy before parent requirements freeze.

status_definitions.DEFINED_STRUCTURE: Failure mode and evidence path are identified, but product-specific limits and classifications are still open.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_G1_G2: Cannot be closed until parent electrical/architecture requirements freeze.
status_definitions.OPEN: A required product decision or value is not yet available.

scoring_policy.rule: No numerical FMEA score or safety-integrity classification is assigned until vehicle safety policy, architecture and evidence are available.

failure_modes.local_effect: semiconductor and shunt stress; uncontrolled torque possible until switching is inhibited
failure_modes.system_effect: propulsion loss or abnormal thrust is possible
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: asynchronous switching inhibit path required; exact latency OPEN
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: fault classification, telemetry and frozen re-arm policy

failure_modes.failure_mode: DC-bus overvoltage including regenerative or BMS/contact disconnect transient
failure_modes.local_effect: MOSFET, gate-driver, auxiliary supply and DC-link voltage stress
failure_modes.system_effect: ESC shutdown, device damage or propulsion loss possible
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: response depends on frozen energy-management architecture; no clamp/disconnect action assumed
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: fault logging and policy-defined torque/switching response

failure_modes.failure_mode: DC-bus undervoltage / severe sag / partial power
failure_modes.local_effect: control/gate-drive domains may brown out or enter invalid operating regions
failure_modes.system_effect: loss of commanded thrust or uncontrolled restart risk if sequencing is poor
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: PWM permission shall be false in unsupported partial-power states
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: restart/re-arm behavior must follow frozen policy

failure_modes.failure_mode: gate-driver fault, UVLO, configuration loss or invalid enable state
failure_modes.local_effect: one or more switches may be disabled or driven incorrectly depending on fault mode
failure_modes.system_effect: torque disturbance or propulsion loss possible
detection_candidates: SPI status if smart driver selected
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: hardware-safe output state required; exact behavior depends on selected driver

failure_modes.failure_mode: MCU reset, watchdog trip, firmware hang or invalid startup
failure_modes.local_effect: motor-control outputs and state machine unavailable or invalid
failure_modes.system_effect: propulsion interruption; uncontrolled PWM must be prevented by hardware architecture
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: controlled boot diagnostics and deliberate re-arm only per final policy

failure_modes.failure_mode: CAN communication loss, stuck traffic, bus-off or invalid command freshness
failure_modes.local_effect: ESC no longer has trustworthy vehicle command/telemetry exchange
failure_modes.system_effect: vehicle thrust command can become stale or unavailable
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: timeout/failsafe action shall be deterministic and traceable

failure_modes.failure_mode: current-sense open/short/saturation/gain error or invalid sample timing
failure_modes.local_effect: FOC feedback and overcurrent estimation can become wrong
failure_modes.system_effect: torque error or loss of protection margin possible
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: OPEN by fault class; severe invalid sensing shall not be silently accepted

failure_modes.failure_mode: bus/phase voltage sense open/short/backfeed/saturation or power-sequencing fault
failure_modes.local_effect: invalid voltage telemetry/control input; possible unintended rail injection in poor architectures
failure_modes.system_effect: incorrect control/protection decisions or partial-power corruption
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: OPEN by fault class; architecture shall not rely on unpowered MCU rail sinking HV-divider current
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: invalid sensor state shall be recognized before arming where required

failure_modes.failure_mode: MOSFET/PCB/motor overtemperature or temperature-sensor invalid state
failure_modes.local_effect: thermal overstress or unavailable protection estimate
failure_modes.system_effect: derating, shutdown or propulsion loss depending on final policy
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: OPEN pending thermal architecture and vehicle policy
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: temperature derating/shutdown thresholds and sensor-fault handling required

failure_modes.failure_mode: external inhibit asserted, open wire, short or disconnected interface
failure_modes.local_effect: inhibit state may be ambiguous if interface is not designed for wiring-fault detection
failure_modes.system_effect: requested shutdown may be missed or nuisance shutdown may occur
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: report and latch behavior per frozen policy

failure_modes.failure_mode: 12V/5V/3V3/analog-rail overvoltage, undervoltage, short, overload or backfeed
failure_modes.local_effect: driver/control/sensing functions can enter invalid states
failure_modes.system_effect: loss of control or unsafe partial-power sequencing possible
failure_modes.required_immediate_response: PWM permission false in unsupported partial-power states
failure_modes.required_firmware_response: fault logging and deliberate restart policy

failure_modes.failure_mode: open, intermittent, reversed/mismated, high-resistance or mechanically released connector/contact
failure_modes.local_effect: power, sensor or communication path loss / heating depending on interface
failure_modes.system_effect: propulsion loss, erroneous sensing or network loss possible
detection_candidates: voltage drop/temperature evidence for power paths

required_next_fields_before_G2_closure: vehicle-level effect and degraded-operation policy per failure mode
severity classification method and approved values
occurrence evidence source if scoring is used
anti_hallucination_rule: No empty safety classification, score, timeout, current, voltage, temperature or latency field may be populated from generic engineering convention or competitor data. Unknowns remain null/OPEN until parent requirements or measurements exist.
